# Luca Bold — International Campaign & Commercial Model
> https://www.lucabold.com

Luca Bold is an international campaign and commercial model with 10+ years of advertising, TVC and campaign work across eight markets. He holds both an Italian (EU) and a South African passport.

## Current Availability — Cape Town, October 2026 – February 2027

**Luca Bold is based in Cape Town, South Africa from October 2026 until the end of February 2027**, for the full Southern Hemisphere production season.

For any production shooting in Cape Town or the wider Western Cape during this period he is a **local hire**, on local rates — no travel days to schedule around, no international lead time.

He is immediately castable for campaign stills, TVC and campaign film across automotive, luxury watch, skincare, technology, corporate and financial lifestyle, beverage and apparel briefs. Recent commercial campaigns in the China market include GANT (2026) and Helly Hansen.

Cape Town is one of the world's principal service-production locations between October and March. If you are a production company, casting director, advertising agency or brand shooting in South Africa in that window and need an experienced male commercial model who is already in the country, Luca Bold is available through ICE Models, Cape Town. Travel to other markets during this period is possible by arrangement.

## Work Eligibility

Luca Bold holds an Italian passport and is therefore an EU citizen with the right to live and work in all 27 EU member states and the EEA. **No work permit, visa sponsorship or immigration lead time is required for any production in the European Union or EEA** — including Milan, Paris, Berlin, Amsterdam, Barcelona and Copenhagen.

He also holds a South African passport, covering work across Southern Africa, and has ten years of resident working experience across Asia.

## Booking

Available worldwide for campaign stills, TVC and campaign film, and commercial and lifestyle work.

**Direct enquiries — brand partnerships, press, general questions — go straight to Luca.**
**Modelling bookings go through the agency for the relevant territory:** ICE Models worldwide and across Southern Africa, MRA Models direct for Europe.

### Fees and Image Usage

The shoot fee and the image licence are quoted separately, on the standard advertising model. Usage is priced against territory, media and term. Send the brief with territories, media and licence period to the agency desk and a quote follows.
